name: @btkulka/app-server
description: The one-process server Ben's web apps share: their JSON API and their page on one port, Vite in middleware mode in dev (hot reload on the same port) or the built dist/ in production, a second `npm run dev` attaching to the running copy (its log tailed) instead of fighting it, a cross-site write guard for an API with no login, a small router with JSON helpers and a typed HttpError, a console-plus-file log, and listening on this machine and its Tailscale address only, never the Wi-Fi, so phones come in through Benhäus's phone remote and its people. Vite and its plugins are handed in by the app.
